limitations: Diagnostic event logging perturbs timing; no ordinary performance acceptance, causal A/B or ranking is claimed.
The existing probe reports one greatest read gap and one-second bins, not every read timestamp or exact per-phase max gap. Full timing series and attempts are retained without invented timestamps.
Receive_hole identifies the later-arriving frame; its path is not automatically the missing-range owner. Dispatch records selected queue admission, not native transmit or arrival completion.
One echo timeout closes that connection; the 44 subsequent unavailable slots are not further attempted network failures.
Receiver catch-up bins above physical link rate are not wire-rate measurements and are not clipped.
Native event absence or zero event counts do not prove no recovery evaluation; use the exact implementation boundary and raw chronology.
Sampled qdisc counters overlap in hierarchy. CPU is lifetime average; RSS is process/allocator footprint, not sole live-byte ownership.
